app.name: Witness
app.tagline: Camera vitals that show their work.
home.replayHint: Synthetic demo data generated by Witness, not SmartSpectra output.
home.noSdk: The camera SDK isn't available in this build. Replays still work.
home.promise: No reading without a clean window.
key.title: Paste your SmartSpectra key
key.body: Witness runs Presage's SmartSpectra SDK on this computer. It needs your own free API key. The key is stored encrypted by your operating system and is only ever given to the SDK.
key.invalid: That doesn't look like a key. Paste it again, without spaces.
key.memoryOnly: This computer has no keychain, so the key is kept for this session only.
consent.title: Witness uses your camera to estimate your pulse, breathing and HRV from tiny colour and motion changes in your face and chest.
consent.video: Video stays on this computer and is never saved.
consent.presage: Presage's SDK contacts Presage to check the API key and count minutes used.
consent.insights: During a check-in, the SDK may also send pulse, breathing and HRV numbers (never video) to Presage's AI service. Witness can't switch this off and shows no AI text unless you ask for it.
consent.saved: Only the verified numbers you save are kept, encrypted on this computer, for {days} days. Delete them any time.
consent.stop: Minimizing or hiding the window stops the camera. Only one face can be in view.
consent.wellness: General wellness only, not medical advice.
consent.compact: Don't show the full text again
consent.summary: Camera on, video stays here, verified numbers only, stop any time. Wellness only.
consent.replayNote: This is a replay of synthetic data. The camera stays off.
camcheck.title: Checking your camera
camcheck.body: A few seconds to measure its frame rate and brightness. SmartSpectra stops below 25 fps, so this check runs before it starts and uses no Presage minutes.
camcheck.measuring: Measuring frame rate and light. Sit where you'll check in.
camcheck.anyway: Start anyway (SmartSpectra may stop early and still count the minutes)
camcheck.denied: Camera permission was refused. Allow camera access for Witness in your system privacy settings (Windows: Settings → Privacy & security → Camera), then check again.
camcheck.busy: The camera is in use by another app. Close it (Zoom, Teams, a browser tab, the Camera app) and check again.
camcheck.failed: The camera couldn't be turned on. Try another camera, or reconnect it and check again.
camcheck.fallback: Using {label}: at {first} this camera gave only {fps} fps.
camcheck.triedLower: Lower resolutions were tried too and didn't reach 25 fps, so this is the light or the camera itself.
measure.tuning: Getting the camera ready. Sit about an arm's length away, face the screen, keep your shoulders in view.
complete.title: Check-in finished
complete.nothing: No reading had a clean window this time. Nothing was saved. Try again somewhere with steady light, and stay still and quiet.
history.title: History
history.ghost: Show what the SDK alone would have shown
data.title: Your data
data.where: Saved check-ins hold only verified values and their receipts, encrypted on this computer. No video, images, face landmarks or expressions are ever stored.
data.deleted: Deleted. Nothing about you remains in Witness.
data.telemetryHint: Session summaries and readiness reports. No frames or vitals. Off by default.
disclaimer: General wellness information, not medical advice. Camera readings can be wrong. If you feel unwell, contact a health professional.
